subject: Short-term log retention for PoC + SIG/CAIQ artifacts
messages:
From: Allen Hsu <allen.hsu@luminarhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short-term log retention for PoC + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Hi Jasmine,

We are preparing to run a 60–90 day PoC with Redwood and have a couple of security/compliance asks before we turn on tenant tracing at scale:  

1) For debugging during the PoC we need to retain richer request/response traces for a single tenant for up to 90 days. Can Redwood provide a temporary exception to the default 30d debug log TTL specifically scoped to the PoC tenant? We need details on what is included (request headers, model prompts, token-level metadata, any PII redaction applied) and the operational controls (who can access, audit logging).

2) Please confirm whether deleted logs are removed from backups or snapshotting systems, and the expected proof-of-delete process (timeline + artifacts).

3) We also need your completed SIG questionnaire and the CAIQ/SOC2 evidence links. Our InfoSec team will review and send a short questionnaire back.

Can you share an interim approach that minimizes risk while allowing our engineers to debug? Attached is our PoC security checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Allen Hsu
Principal Security Engineer
Luminar Health

Attachments: luminar-poc-security-checklist.pdf

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Allen Hsu <allen.hsu@luminarhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short-term log retention for PoC + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Allen — thanks for the clear list. I copied Ben (security ops) and Neha (legal/compliance) to scope the path forward. High level answer below; we can attach artifacts and a draft DPA clause for the temporary retention carve-out.

Summary proposed approach (interim, for PoC only):
- Scope: single tenant ID only; keep standard production telemetry off by default; enable tenant-scoped debug traces (request/response prompts + token metadata + trace ids). No full system-level traces.
- Retention window: configurable up to 90 days for this tenant; default afterwards is automated purge to our immutable delete queue.
- Access controls: RBAC only to engineering outage responders and assigned Luminar contacts; all access requires justification and is recorded in audit logs.
- Redaction: PII-sensitive fields are redacted by default using our prompt-capture filters; we will run an additional redaction pass for this tenant and provide a sampling report pre- and post-redaction.
- Backups & snapshots: our backup policy rotates daily snapshots and we mark PoC tenant data for expedited deletion on snapshot lifecycle. We will provide a proof-of-delete package consisting of deletion manifests and snapshot metadata (see below).
- Contractual guardrails: we require a signed DPA addendum that limits the carve-out to the PoC timeframe and scopes data types. Neha will propose language.

I attached a short MOP for how we'll implement tenant-limited debug traces (debug-retention-mop.docx) and a redacted SIG exec summary (SIG-completed-2026.pdf). Links to the full SIG/CAIQ bundle are below.

Next steps: Ben to confirm operational steps and produce the proof-of-delete checklist; Neha to share DPA wording; if acceptable I will schedule a 30-minute sync to walk through the exact fields we'll retain.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-completed-2026.pdf; debug-retention-mop.docx

Cc: Luminar Health Security <security@luminarhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-term log retention for PoC + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifying items before we sign the DPA addendum:  

- Backups: when you say "expedited deletion on snapshot lifecycle," can you confirm whether there are any offsite or long-term archive copies that could still contain the PoC tenant traces for longer than 90 days? Our legal team will want to understand all persistence points (hot backups, cold archives, object-store versioning).

- Proof-of-delete: what is the expected timeline after the PoC ends? For example, do you provide a deletion manifest within X days and a cryptographic hash/proof of wipe?

- Evidence artifacts: if possible please share the CAIQ pack link and any SOC2 narrative on log retention and snapshots so our auditors can review.

We can do the 30‑minute sync but wanted the above answered in writing first.

-Allen

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Allen Hsu <allen.hsu@luminarhealth.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Short-term log retention for PoC + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Allen — hi, Ben here (security ops). Quick answers and what we'll deliver in the PoC closeout packet:  

1) Persistence points:
- Hot storage: tenant traces are written to encrypted object storage (AES-256). We do daily snapshots; for PoC tenants we will mark snapshots for retention TTL=0 meaning they become eligible for deletion on next lifecycle rotation.
- Offsite/archives: we do not tier PoC tenant debug traces into cold-archive buckets by default; long-term archives are system-level and exclude tenant-scoped debug traces unless explicitly requested and contracted.
- Object-store versioning: we will disable versioning for the PoC tenant debug object prefix to avoid lingering versions.

2) Proof-of-delete & timeline:
- We provide a deletion manifest within 7 business days of the retention window close; manifest includes keys deleted, timestamps, and the snapshot ids removed.
- For additional cryptographic assurance we can provide an S3 lifecycle log and MD5 object checksums pre/post deletion; we do not provide on-chain proofs but we can include signed manifests stamped by our security ops team.

3) Artifacts: attached CAIQ bundle and SOC2 narrative links in the shared Drive. Neha is drafting the DPA addendum clause that limits the TTL to the PoC timeframe and explicitly excludes backup/archive tiers. 

Deliverables (will drop into the Drive folder listed below):
- CAIQ package (full)
- SOC2 retention narrative (section excerpt)
- DPA addendum draft (dpa-draft-retain-clause.docx)
- PoC closeout proof-of-delete template

I'll upload the artifacts by EOD today and we can take the 30-minute sync after you and legal have had a look.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: dpa-draft-retain-clause.docx
